description: Dispatcher.City searches the live public Berlin property map for homes to buy or rent, WG rooms, new builds, and commercial listings. It returns canonical source links together with exact snapshot counts and explicit coverage and confirmation limits. The public plugin is read-only and cannot access accounts, save searches, enable alerts, contact brokers, or make decisions.
